claims.text: Won the up-to-62 kg men's category at the WCSF World Combat Sambo Championship in Moscow, 11-12 December 2015, representing Russia (listed as Omar Nurmagomedov).
His UFC profile lists world combat sambo champion among his titles.

sambo.note: The title is from the WCSF (World Combat Sambo Federation) World Championships, Moscow, 11-12 Dec 2015, not the FIAS World Championships (Casablanca, Nov 2015), whose 62 kg combat sambo result does not include him; these are different events, not a conflict.
